description:
Add the usage_rules dev dependency (1.2.x) and configure it in mix.exs so `mix usage_rules.sync` writes a managed section (between usage-rules-start/end markers) into AGENTS.md. Contents (maintainer's choice): usage_rules' own rules (how to use `mix usage_rules.docs` and `mix usage_rules.search_docs`), plus the built-in :elixir and :otp rules. Of current deps only igniter ships usage-rules.md, and defk writes no Igniter code, so it is left out. Keep the hand-written part of AGENTS.md as the source of project rules and say that it wins where the generic rules disagree (e.g. macros are the product here; measure before choosing Stream over Enum). Add `usage_rules.sync --check` to the ci alias so the section can't drift from the deps.

Done when: mix.exs has the dep and config, AGENTS.md carries the generated section, AGENTS.md explains how to regenerate and which rules win, and mix ci passes.
title: Add usage_rules: sync dependency usage rules and doc-lookup tasks into AGENTS.md
